WITH budget_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    e.event_id,
    e.location,
    CASE 
      WHEN b.amount IS NOT NULL AND b.amount != 0 THEN (b.spent - b.amount) / CAST(b.amount AS FLOAT)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS overspend_ratio
  FROM event e
  JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
),
event_avg_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    event_id,
    location,
    AVG(overspend_ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM budget_ratios
  GROUP BY event_id, location
),
ranked_events AS (
  SELECT 
    event_id,
    location,
    avg_ratio,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY CASE WHEN avg_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, avg_ratio DESC) AS rank
  FROM event_avg_ratios
)
SELECT 
  event_id,
  location,
  avg_ratio,
  rank
FROM ranked_events
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY location, rank
